name: wideo11-monorepo
description: Wideo11 Video Platform - Monorepo with Next.js, Go microservices, and custom observability
//dependencies: The root manifest is ALSO the hoist target. Every app's Docker image runs `pnpm install` with `shamefully-hoist`, which flattens the whole workspace into this directory's node_modules and lets the FIRST writer win each package name. Without a declared version here the winner is whichever app happened to be installed first, and the image silently builds against a different copy of the dependency than the workspace does.
//dependencies-lucide-react: Four apps pin four different lucide-react versions (0.321 / 0.400 / 0.428 / 0.454). The video editor declares ^0.400.0 and must get 0.400.0: an older build resolves different icon internals between the server and browser bundles, which is a hydration mismatch and a console error on every page load. Declaring it here pins the hoisted copy to the version the editor actually declares.

engines.npm: Please use pnpm instead of npm strictly
